name: Scribbble 0.13.0
body:
## Changelog

### ✨ New

- 🎨 **A real palette, at your fingertips** — ten well-thought colors that read against anything replace the system color picker. `1`–`9` and `0` switch colors without leaving the canvas; `C` opens the palette. 
- 🖱️ **Click the Dock icon to toggle** — tap it to summon the overlay, tap again to send it away. Same as your toggle shortcut (`⌥Space` by default).

name: Scribbble 0.12.0
body: ## Changelog ### ✨ New - 🫧 **Auto-fade** (`F`) — everything you draw quietly dissolves a few seconds after you lift the pen. Hover the button to pick Quick or 1–10s; Hold `⌃` while drawing to fade just one mark — or, with the mode on, to keep one. -

name: Scribbble 0.11.0
body:
## Changelog

✨ New

- 🧭 Dock the toolbar anywhere - top and bottom join left and right.
- 🖥️ Multi-monitor support - follows your cursor across displays — the overlay now shows up on whichever screen you're actually looking at, not the one it launched on.
- 🥚 A little secret - ⌘-click anywhere on the toolbar and see what happens.

💅 Polished

- 🫧 More polished design for the toolbar and crispier icons!
- ⌨️ The shortcuts overlay got real keycaps and a tidier layout.

🐛 Fixed

- 🖥️ Scribbble now works over fullscreen apps.

name: Scribbble 0.10.0
body:
### Changelog

✨ New

- 🧑‍🏫 Whiteboard Tool (W) — blank the screen and draw on a proper board. White or chalkboard green, plain / ruled / grid / dotted. Board doodles stay with the board: dismiss it and your desktop scribbles are exactly where you left them. [Pro only]
- 🧹 Clear annotations on app toggle — new toggle under Tools, on by default. Flip it off to keep your drawing across a hide.

🐛 Fixed

- 🖍️ Text and measurements no longer come out ghostly after using the highlighter.
- 📏 Measure stopped stamping duplicates every time your cursor wandered onto the toolbar.
- 💥 No more crash on launch on macOS 13 and earlier.
- 🔶 The Shapes button no longer turns up blank without a license.

name: Scribbble 0.9.2

name: Scribbble 0.9.1
body:
## Changelog

- Scribbble crashed on launch on macOS 13 Ventura and earlier; it now opens normally there. (macOS 12.3 is the minimum supported version.)
- The Shapes toolbar button appeared blank without a Pro license — its icon now shows for everyone.

name: Scribbble 0.9.0
body:
## Changelog

### New

- **Magnify tool** (`Z`) — a loupe that follows your cursor with live 2x magnified screen content. `+` / `-` resize the lens. Pro feature, requires macOS 15.2+.
- **Localization** — now available in English, French, Spanish, Chinese, Japanese, Dutch, German, and Hindi. Auto-detected from your system locale, changeable in Settings → General.
- **Update dialog** — "Check for updates…" now shows what's happening: checking, up to date, the new version and its notes, or the error.

### Changed

- Updates no longer install themselves. Previously a check that found a release relaunched the app unannounced, discarding your drawing. You now choose when to install.
- Settings are organized into General and Tools tabs.

### Fixed

- Update checks could stall for days on a sleeping laptop. They now track wall-clock time, so sleeping or restarting doesn't reset the schedule.

name: Scribbble 0.8.0
body:
## Changelog

- Setting available to hide Scribbble from dock and app switcher
- Performance improvements - lesser CPU, lesser memory usage

name: Scribbble 0.7.0
body:

- Minimize just the toolbar with `\` key

name: Scribbble 0.6.0
body:
## Changelog

- [New] Shape tool - Draw rectangles (R), ellipsis (E) and arrows (A) to make your scribbbles convey better! You can cycle through the shapes using `]` key too.

name: Scribbble 0.5.0
body:
## Changelog

  - **Snapshot tool** (Pro) — capture the screen plus your annotations to the clipboard or save to disk (`~/Downloads`). Region-capture supported via ⌘⇧C / ⌘⇧S or Shift+click the snapshot button. With configurable shutter sound effect. 📸
  - **Custom cursors** for each drawing tool.
  - **Toolbar position** — choose left or right side of the screen from Settings.
  - **Color and brush size persist** across launches (toggle in Settings).
